items.evidence: Performance goals: For fiscal 2018, the ECC determined that for MIP, annual adjusted pre-tax income was an appropriate and effective measure to motivate, focus, and reward operational performance across the company
cumulative three-year adjusted pre-tax income was an appropriate and effective metric to motivate, focus, and reward operational performance across the company over a longer time horizon
the ECC also established the LRPIP adjusted pre-tax income target for this new three-year cycle based on aggregate targets for all divisions (without divisional weightings)
Full performance vesting requires a LRPIP payout of not less than 67% for the applicable cycle
